summary: A mixed day dominated by Reliance's blockbuster Jio Platforms IPO filing and strong retail earnings, alongside a significant RBI regulatory action against Paytm Payments Bank and a Kerala High Court employment rights ruling.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms files for IPO on October 21, seeking $114 billion valuation.
RBI removes Paytm Payments Bank from scheduled banks list following April licence cancellation for regulatory non-compliance.
Kalyan Jewellers Q2 revenue grows 26%, India business up 27% ahead of festive season.
Kerala High Court rules principal cannot be denied entry for wearing churidar, upholding dress code freedom.
India's quick commerce market projected to grow seven-fold to $90 billion by FY31 from current base.
